name: mcptoon
shrinks: MCP tool schemas and discovery overhead
about: A Python CLI that keeps MCP tool definitions out of your context window, reducing discovery tokens by 99.2% while maintaining full tool access through shell commands.

setup.purpose: Register mcptoon with Claude Code as a skill

notes: mcptoon is a zero-dependency CLI that works with any agent that can run shell commands.
MCP servers stay configured in your system, but their schemas never enter your agent's context.
Use `mcptoon manifest --compact` to see all tool names in approximately 117 tokens instead of 71k+.
Newer versions automatically inject the /mcptoon skill into detected Claude Code sessions.
